name: Times club monthly special crossword No 20,275

solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Derision of WI cheat stops one without manners

indicators.note: something that stops a gap sits inside it, like a cork in a bottle neck

blocks.note: a pig is a greedy, ill-mannered person
to con is to swindle

explanation.surface: Someone sneers at a West Indian cheat who barges in on a boorish companion.
explanation.walkthrough: WI is West Indies: the answer is a Caribbean word, and the clue tells you where it is used.
explanation.definitionFit: In Trinidad and the wider Caribbean, picong means teasing, mocking banter traded between rivals.

clue.text: Something in compact disc’s intro, doubtful vocalisation in Wham! turned up very loud

indicators.note: an intro is the opening, so only the first letter of disc is wanted
in a down entry, turned up means read from bottom to top, so the word up runs the other way

blocks.note: a comic-book sound of a blow
the opening letter of disc
the hesitant noise someone makes when unsure
the word up, flipped
fortissimo, the musical marking for very loud

explanation.surface: A pop fan describes the sounds of a compact disc of Wham!, played at full volume.
explanation.walkthrough: Compact is not the music disc but a woman's make-up compact; the pieces read POW, D, ER, PU, FF.
explanation.definitionFit: A powder puff is the soft pad kept in a cosmetics case for dabbing face powder on.

clue.text: Minute interval when pacifist introduces extreme combat sport

blocks.note: conscientious objector, someone who refuses military service
mixed martial arts, the cage-fighting sport

explanation.surface: A tiny pause as a peace-lover ushers in a brutal fighting sport.
explanation.walkthrough: Introduces simply puts the pacifist first.
explanation.definitionFit: In music theory a comma is a tiny difference in pitch, far smaller than a semitone.

clue.text: To bother with last of plumbing sister grips power tool

indicators.note: to grip something is to hold it tight inside your hand, so the sister surrounds the rest
last of asks for only the closing letter of the following word

blocks.note: a nun is a religious sister
to ail is to trouble or afflict
the final letter of plumbing

explanation.surface: A nun, fed up with the plumbing, picks up a power tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A nail gun is a pneumatic or electric device that drives fasteners into wood, so it counts as workshop machinery.

clue.text: Express pleasure in bets, flipping gold coin

indicators.note: flipping something turns it over, so the word for bets is read backwards
in puts the sound of pleasure inside the other word

blocks.note: to lay a bet is to wager, so lays are bets
a cat purrs when contented

explanation.surface: A gambler is delighted with the wagers when a gold coin is tossed.
explanation.walkthrough: To lay is the bookmaker's term for accepting a bet, which is why bets can be lays.
explanation.definitionFit: The spur-ryal was a gold piece minted under James I, named for the star pattern like a rowel.

clue.text: Lotus position and difficult Mountain asana for beginners

indicators.note: beginners are the starting letters, so each word gives up only its first letter

blocks.note: the opening letters of the five words

explanation.surface: A yoga teacher lists the lotus pose and the hard mountain pose as challenges for newcomers.
explanation.walkthrough: Lotus position is a yoga pose, but the definition is only Lotus; position starts the acrostic.
explanation.definitionFit: Padma is the Sanskrit name for the sacred water lily of Indian art and religion.

clue.text: Do a new scaling of play area extension

blocks.note: a rec is a recreation ground, the British term for a public playing field
a limb extends from the body or from a building

explanation.surface: A council redraws the plan of a playground extension at a new scale.
explanation.definitionFit: To go up a mountain or wall again is to ascend it a second time.

clue.text: Unknown person typically hugging the man with two-way attraction produces aphrodisiac

indicators.note: something hugging another wraps its arms round it, so this word goes outside

blocks.note: y is a standard unknown in algebra
one, as in one does, means a typical person
the pronoun for a man
short for bisexual, attracted both ways

explanation.surface: An anonymous bisexual embraces a man, and a love potion is the result.
explanation.walkthrough: The unknown and the person are separate pieces: only the person does the hugging.
explanation.definitionFit: Yohimbine is an alkaloid from African tree bark long reputed to boost sexual desire.

clue.text: Did you ever walk out?

indicators.note: out suggests being put out of order, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written, as fodder

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether you have ever gone on strike.
explanation.walkthrough: Walk out looks like a phrase for striking; out is the signal to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Lawk is an old exclamation of surprise, a form of Lord, much as one gasps in disbelief.

clue.text: Senussi leader or king, one occupying one of two parts of the Muslim era

indicators.note: a thing occupying a space is inside it, so the one goes inside the following word

blocks.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king
each of two equal parts is a half
the Roman numeral for one
anno Hegirae, the dating of years from the Hegira

explanation.surface: A historian dates the Senussi leader or king by the halves of the Islamic calendar.
explanation.walkthrough: The Senussi are a Sufi order of Libya. One appears twice: once inside, once as part of the phrase for a half.
explanation.definitionFit: A khalifah is a caliph, the successor or spiritual head of a Muslim order such as the Senussi.

clue.text: Heading away from Slough (initially in Slough), waved from Waverley?

indicators.note: the heading of a word is its first letter, and it is taken off
initially points to only the first letter of the next word

blocks.note: a slough is a bog or marsh
the first letter of in
to slough a skin is to cast it off

explanation.surface: Someone who has left the Berkshire town of Slough says goodbye from Edinburgh's Waverley station.
explanation.walkthrough: Slough appears twice, first as a noun meaning marsh, then as a verb meaning cast off. Waverley is Walter Scott's novel, flagging a Scots word.
explanation.definitionFit: Wampish is a Scots verb meaning to wave about or flourish, as used by Walter Scott.

clue.text: The way to follow something like a nocturnal seabird

blocks.note: circa, meaning about or approximately
how means the way or manner

explanation.surface: A birdwatcher explains how to track a seabird that is only active after dark.
explanation.definitionFit: The cahow is the Bermuda petrel, a rare ocean bird that comes ashore only after dark.

clue.text: Universal image distorted in mass materials

indicators.note: something distorted has been twisted out of shape, so these letters are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written, as fodder

explanation.surface: A worldwide picture is warped when it appears in the media.
explanation.walkthrough: Mass materials sounds like media for the masses, but mass is the church service.
explanation.definitionFit: An evangeliarium is a book containing the Gospel passages read at the Eucharist, so these are liturgical books.

clue.text: During long nap, a naked, private and deliberate incongruity

indicators.note: during means within the span of, so what follows the next phrase goes inside it

blocks.note: shag is a cloth or carpet with a long rough pile
taken as written
raw can mean bare or exposed
a GI is an American private soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier takes a long nap in the nude, a deliberately odd thing to do.
explanation.walkthrough: Nap is the pile of a fabric, not a sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: Sharawaggi is the art of irregular, asymmetrical garden design, valued for studied disorder.

clue.text: Hickory stick, tip first, is behind pressure

indicators.note: the tip of a stick is its far end, and bringing it to the front rotates the letters

blocks.note: P is the physics symbol for pressure
a cane is a walking stick

explanation.surface: A hickory walking stick is propped up behind something, pointed end first.
explanation.walkthrough: Tip first moves the last letter of the stick word to its front.
explanation.definitionFit: The pecan is a North American nut tree belonging to the walnut family, a species of the genus Carya.

clue.text: A wand’ring minstrel, I have skill to check trio after Nanki-Poo’s head

indicators.note: a trio is three, so the three letters that come after the opening one are kept

blocks.note: to be able to do something
to keep tabs on is to check
the second, third and fourth letters, after the initial N

explanation.surface: Nanki-Poo, singing his song from The Mikado, boasts of the skill that keeps a trio in line.
explanation.walkthrough: A wand'ring minstrel I is Nanki-Poo's opening song in Gilbert and Sullivan's The Mikado, so the singer defines himself.
explanation.definitionFit: A cantabank is a strolling singer, a ballad-monger who performed on street platforms.

clue.text: No more trivial banter, outwardly banal: maybe skate around it

indicators.note: outwardly means on the outside, so only the outer letters of banal are taken
around means surrounding, so the creature wraps round the rest

blocks.note: the skate is an example of a flat fish
to rib is to tease
the first and last letters of banal

explanation.surface: Trivial banter is over: someone urges that it be bypassed like a skater swerving.
explanation.walkthrough: No more marks the word as obsolete; skate is the fish, not the ice.
explanation.definitionFit: Fribblish is an obsolete adjective meaning frivolous and trifling, from fribble, an idle trifler.

clue.text: Because of corrosion, leaky cork is in crumbs

indicators.note: something that crumbs breaks into fragments, so the letters are broken up and rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written, as fodder

explanation.surface: A wine bottle leaks because its stopper has crumbled.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface invites a corked bottle, but the word describes a wooden ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Iron-sick describes a ship whose bolts have rusted, letting the planking work loose and take in water.

clue.text: Scandinavian rounds stuffed with Greek character’s herb

indicators.note: something stuffed with filling has it inside, so the Greek letter goes within

blocks.note: a native of Finland
two round letters
the twenty-second letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Nordic cook stuffs round pastries with a herb, apparently a Greek's recipe.
explanation.walkthrough: Rounds are two letter Os, one either side of the Greek letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Finnochio is a spelling of Florence fennel, the aniseed-flavoured plant used as a vegetable.

clue.text: Shortest book of Ring opera mounted for the insiders in Bayreuth

indicators.note: in a down entry, mounted means set upwards, so the opera's name runs bottom to top
only the outer letters stay, as the inside ones are being swapped out
for means in place of, so one thing replaces another

blocks.note: a ring is O-shaped
the first and last letters of Bayreuth
Verdi's opera

explanation.surface: Wagner's Ring cycle is staged at the Bayreuth festival for the select few.
explanation.walkthrough: Ring and Bayreuth point to Wagner, but the opera is Verdi's; ADIA replaces the middle of Bayreuth.
explanation.definitionFit: Obadiah is the briefest volume of the Old Testament, a single chapter of prophecy.

clue.text: Noble husband blocks former spouse

indicators.note: something that blocks a passage sits inside it, so the husband goes within

blocks.note: a peer is a member of the nobility
the abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: A titled husband stands in the way of his ex-wife.
explanation.walkthrough: Former spouse looks like an ex, but former flags an archaic word.
explanation.definitionFit: Pheer is a Spenserian spelling of fere, an old word for a companion or mate.

clue.text: Reverse flow in freedom of movement, not going through normal channels

indicators.note: reverse means run backwards, so the word for flow is read the other way
in places the backwards flow inside the following word

blocks.note: to run is to flow
play is the slack that lets a part move

explanation.surface: Bureaucrats grant freedom of movement but bypass the proper procedures.
explanation.walkthrough: Normal channels sounds like official routes, but here they are the body's own passages.
explanation.definitionFit: Planury is the discharge of urine through an abnormal passage, a medical term.

clue.text: When over front, northern spring breaking possible flight for bird found in Georgia

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the word for when is read backwards
breaking into something means getting inside it

blocks.note: as can mean when
the van is the front of an army
the abbreviation for northern
an arrow may be in flight, so a flight in principle
a spa is a mineral spring

explanation.surface: Weather talk: a front comes in, a northern spring cuts short a flight for a bird in Georgia.
explanation.walkthrough: Georgia hints at Savannah, the port city in the US state; the spring breaks in after the first letter of the flight.
explanation.definitionFit: The savanna sparrow is a small streaked songbird of North American grassland, including the southern states.

clue.text: What’s notable in vegan omelette but not energy drinks?

indicators.note: but not means excluding, so the energy symbol is removed

blocks.note: the striking thing about an omelette made for vegans is the lack of any egg
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A puzzled diner asks what makes a vegan omelette, then wonders about energy drinks.
explanation.walkthrough: Energy drinks reads as one phrase, but energy is only E to remove, and drinks is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A nog is a strong old ale brewed in East Anglia, and also an egg-based festive beverage.

clue.text: Not all areas that produce Arbroath smokies?

indicators.note: not all of the phrase is needed, only a stretch from inside it

blocks.note: the run of letters across the two words

explanation.surface: A question whether only some parts of the coast make the famous Scottish smoked fish.
explanation.walkthrough: An Arbroath smokie is a haddock cured over smoke in the Scottish fishing town of Arbroath.
explanation.definitionFit: Reast is a Scots verb meaning to cure fish or meat by drying it in smoke.

clue.text: Mate in India or Burma, not the first to skip New Mexico

indicators.note: not the first means without the opening letter
to skip something is to leave it out

blocks.note: Myanmar is the current official name of Burma
NM is the postal abbreviation for the state of New Mexico

explanation.surface: Someone looks for a friend in India or Burma, missing out a trip to New Mexico.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove the M at the start of MYANMAR, then the NM, leaving YAAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Yaar is a Hindi and Urdu term for a friend or buddy, common in Indian English.

clue.text: Trumpeter’s third note beyond range

blocks.note: an Aga is a British brand of heavy cast-iron kitchen range
mi is the third note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A trumpet player's third note is too high for their range.
explanation.walkthrough: Trumpeter is a bird, not a musician.
explanation.definitionFit: The agami is a South American bird of the trumpeter family, named for its loud calls.

clue.text: Dec’s follower interrupts attempt to gulp down chilli sauce

indicators.note: something that interrupts breaks into the middle, so the month goes inside

blocks.note: to have a go is to try
to chug is to drink in big swallows
January follows December

explanation.surface: A TV presenter's sidekick butts in as someone tries to swallow a hot sauce.
explanation.walkthrough: Dec suggests Ant and Dec, the British TV duo, but it is the month. JAN goes inside GOCHUG.
explanation.definitionFit: Gochujang is a Korean fermented red pepper paste used as a spicy condiment.

clue.text: I’ll leave with a dashing air like a demon

indicators.note: the letter I says it will leave, so it is removed from the word that follows

blocks.note: rakish means jaunty and dashing
as means like
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone swaggers off, leaving like a fiend.
explanation.walkthrough: Rakish with its I removed gives RAKSH, then AS and A.
explanation.definitionFit: A rakshasa is an evil spirit in Hindu mythology, a shape-shifting fiend.

clue.text: Football team touring US hostels closed walkways for exercising

indicators.note: touring means going round, so the team goes round the rest

blocks.note: eleven players, written in Roman numerals
the Y is the American name for a YMCA hostel
a door pushed to is shut

explanation.surface: A football side on tour in America visits hostels and covered walkways for training.
explanation.definitionFit: A xystus was a long roofed portico in an ancient Greek gymnasium where athletes trained.
